rubric_items.reason: All four ticket acceptance criteria map to REQ-1, REQ-2, REQ-4, REQ-5; job cadence is under Out of scope with a reason.
REQs are atomic and checkable; REQ-6 and REQ-16 still say 'within the one day' instead of the 24h-after-start window fixed by A-02 (prior F-2 not fixed).
Every known REQ cites the ticket or an IDE answer that says what the REQ states; nothing invented.
Prior F-1 resolved: the Cancelled-before-it-took-place clash is now recorded as a mismatch on A-03 and A-05 citing the glossary, and REQ-9 states the start time has passed.
Questions were answered in the IDE with real options and defaults; Q-05 was non-blocking; nothing left open needlessly.
Plain and readable; glossary terms used consistently; minor wording drift on the one-day window in REQ-6/REQ-16.
